text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Vietnamese press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-- State President Le Duc Anh and Prime Minister Vo Van Kiet sent a joint message to U.S. President Bill Clinton congratulating him on his reelection.
-- The death toll caused by floods from an atmospheric depression which hit northern and central provinces has risen to 85.
-- American Customs officers will hold an anti-drug training course for customs and control officials in Ho Chi Minh City next week.
-- Vietnam's National Assembly passed amendments to the Foreign Investment Law on Thursday.
-- Army Chief of Staff Pham Van Tra on Thursday began an official friendship visit to Cuba to strengthen solidarity between the two nations.
-- Prime Minister Vo Van Kiet has suggested a series of measures to combat corruption and has called for tough action against teenage drug abuse and the trafficking and sexual abuse of children.
-- South Korean President Kim Young-sam will arrive in Vietnam on November 20 for a three-day official visit.
